brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build contains exactly one node: piece:0,0,0;full (counts piece:1, no adjacent or level+1 nodes).

requirements.requirement: Five drawers in that single base
requirements.evidence: Configurator rule HOST_MISMATCH: a drawer (south half) only attaches to a half variant (e.g., half-n), not to a full base. Half-n offers only one drawer socket (addDrawer key s). Five drawers would require multiple cells/levels beyond a single hex, violating the 'nothing else added' constraint. Tested: full piece gives 0 drawer sockets; half-n gives 1.

finish.summary: Built single hex base as requested (piece:0,0,0;full with no neighbors). Five drawers is unmet: single full base accepts no drawers; single half base accepts at most one drawer due to configurator HOST_MISMATCH rule.
